title: Tate's sealed archive at University of Minnesota
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Tate's sealed archive at University of Minnesota, about 1948-1950 at University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Long story short, we flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting at the University of Minnesota in their archives

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher appearing on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he and others flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting in the archives of the University of Minnesota to see the records of a man named John Torrance Tate, dating from about 1948 to 1950. Ramsay presents these as sealed papers, which also touch on the electronics company Texas Instruments, and treats them as possible evidence of hidden knowledge from the era just after the famous 1947 Roswell crash story.
